title: Camoes Institute Scholarships
provider: Camoes - Instituto da Cooperacao e da Lingua
field: Portuguese language and culture, and fields under bilateral cooperation agreements
description: Scholarships supporting the study of Portuguese language and culture and, under bilateral cooperation programmes, degree study at Portuguese institutions, primarily for students from Portuguese-speaking countries and states with agreements with Portugal.
amount: Tuition support and a monthly maintenance allowance (varies by programme line)

title: FCT PhD Studentships
provider: Fundacao para a Ciencia e a Tecnologia (FCT)
description: Portugal's national doctoral studentship competition, funding PhD research carried out at Portuguese higher education and research institutions, open to applicants of any nationality.
amount: Monthly maintenance allowance of EUR 1,259.64 plus tuition fees, social security and insurance

title: University of Porto Merit Scholarships for International Students
description: Institutional scholarships and tuition reductions for international students admitted to a bachelor's or master's programme at the University of Porto, awarded on academic merit.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction (varies by faculty and programme)

title: NOVA University Lisbon Merit Scholarships
description: Tuition-reduction scholarships for high-achieving international students admitted to a master's programme at one of NOVA's schools.

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Portugal-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Portuguese institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
